interpretation.dataquality_sampling_ablation: Matched category×label quotas; quality covers defect-area strata, random samples within the same quotas. This evaluates area-coverage sampling, not general label cleansing.
interpretation.region_supervision_ablation: Decision-only has no localization result. Compare classification with explicit task/prompt metadata; do not treat absent localization as zero.
interpretation.comparison: Only groups with identical model/input-budget/data/prompt metadata have matched conditions. Different task prompts require a separate protocol explanation.
interpretation.uncertainty: Confidence intervals exist only when present in source metrics; no significance claim is inferred.
